name: Solace Driveworks
description: A large automated industrial complex on Solace II assembling commercial drives and precision field-control systems for Helix customers.
visualDescription: Kilometres of low graphite production halls, bronze gantry markings, enclosed magnetic assembly bays and bright inspection chambers linked by automated freight rails.

image.promptDescription: Huge sci-fi propulsion factory complex, graphite halls with bronze markings, magnetic assembly bays and automated freight lines.

name: Solace Advanced Alloy Works
description: A specialist facility producing precision alloys for propulsion housings, thermal systems and high-stress spacecraft structures.
visualDescription: Dense high-temperature processing halls, clean ingot handling lines and shielded materials laboratories in Helix graphite and bronze.

image.promptDescription: Advanced sci-fi alloy manufacturing complex with high-temperature furnaces, clean material handling and graphite-bronze Helix branding.

name: Varda Closed-Habitat Research Complex
description: A network of sealed growth chambers, biochemical laboratories and pilot-scale food-production modules on Varda Prime.
visualDescription: White low-rise sealed modules surrounded by dark green utility structures, transparent growth galleries and bright clean laboratory interiors.

image.promptDescription: Sealed agricultural bioscience complex with white clean-room modules, dark green utilities, transparent growth galleries and misty coastal atmosphere.
